<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 150 620 400" width="620" height="400">
  <defs>
    <pattern id="dots" width="8" height="8" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <circle cx="2" cy="2" r="1" fill="#000000"/>
    </pattern>
  </defs>
  <rect x="0" y="150" width="620" height="400" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- body of the water gun -->
  <rect x="60" y="216" width="360" height="144" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- water in the tank, dotted fill -->
  <rect x="75" y="231" width="330" height="114" fill="url(#dots)"/>

  <!-- narrow cylinder inside the bottom of the tank -->
  <rect x="144" y="276" width="48" height="84" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- piston on a rod, rod passes down out of the body to the trigger -->
  <line x1="153" y1="312" x2="183" y2="312" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="168" y1="312" x2="168" y2="408" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- trigger linked to the rod, handle angling down and back from under the body -->
  <line x1="168" y1="408" x2="210" y2="438" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="132" y1="360" x2="90" y2="450" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- nozzle leaving the right end of the tank, closed by a stopper -->
  <rect x="405" y="291" width="111" height="18" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="492" y="273" width="24" height="54" fill="#bfbfbf" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- leader lines -->
  <g stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" fill="none">
    <line x1="330" y1="276" x2="330" y2="200"/>
    <line x1="153" y1="312" x2="100" y2="312"/>
    <line x1="210" y1="438" x2="240" y2="462"/>
    <line x1="450" y1="291" x2="488" y2="246"/>
    <line x1="516" y1="327" x2="540" y2="360"/>
  </g>

  <!-- labels -->
  <g font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#000000">
    <text x="330" y="194" text-anchor="middle">water</text>
    <text x="96" y="317" text-anchor="end">piston</text>
    <text x="244" y="466">trigger</text>
    <text x="494" y="240">nozzle</text>
    <text x="544" y="366">stopper</text>
    <text x="240" y="520" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">Fig. 5.1</text>
  </g>
</svg>
